defects.description: Description: 'Drape a length of fabric or a blanket loosely around the body with both hands' — arms should be at chest/shoulder level with hands together in front. But config has BOTH shoulders at -110 (PR-v4 'too-subtle → scale magnitudes' overshoot), producing full overhead abduction (L 178°, R 129°). Hands at y=1.18 — way above head. This is the cross-ankle-sit / shoulder-drop class PR-v4 overshoot defect, but the PR-v4 audit (round 3) MISSED this pose because it's classified 'seated' despite the 'standing' name. No 'raise arms overhead' / 'reach up' phrasing in description.

Description: 'tilt the head back slightly to look upward off-camera'. Derived head_pitch=+20° (forward). Renderer has no neck pitch joint, so head pitch comes from spine + globalTilt. spine:10 (forward) contradicts 'head back'.

regression_risk: medium — 5-field change. Anomalies 2→0 (cleared elbow_above_shoulder because arms no longer overhead). Plausibility 1→1 (right_shoulder_abduction measurement artifact — the convention-mismatch reads negative abduction as 'out of band'). Torso lateral lean increases -2°→+16° as a side effect of spine change under globalTwist — acceptable for a fashion draping pose.
rationale: PR-v4 overshoot fix: shoulders -110→-30 (abduction 178/129→58/-24, arms out at shoulder height for draping). shoulderFwdL/R 10/25→-30/-30 (forward per corrected convention: + = BEHIND, - = FORWARD; brings hands together in front of body for 'draping fabric around body with both hands'). Wrists y: 1.18→0.26 (chest level, between hip 0.119 and shoulder 0.678). spine 10→-10 (sign flip — slight back arch to pitch head backward; head_pitch 20°→11°, reduced forward pitch; renderer has no neck pitch joint so spine is the only lever, and the globalTwist:-60 (profile) means spine rotation has a lateral component — head_roll also increases 9°→27° as side effect, but the primary head-back intent is partially achieved). Note: 'tilt head back SLIGHTLY' is a minor claim; primary defect is the arms overhead. Did NOT change globalTwist (preserves 'profile' intent of standing beside bench).
